blocks.text: Jab radioactive element se alpha ya beta zarra nikalta hai to woh doosre element mein badal jata hai. Radioactive decay bilkul be-tarteeb (random) hai aur kisi tarteeb ki pairvi nahi karta; decay curves mein utaar charhao is be-tarteebi ka saboot hai. Hum nahi bata sakte ke koi khaas atom kab tootega: foran bhi toot sakta hai ya hazaron saal waisa hi reh sakta hai. Yeh khud-ba-khud (spontaneous) bhi hai: atom ke saath hum jo bhi karein woh ise shuru nahi karta. Lekin bohat bare namune mein radioactive nuclei ki tadaad waqt ke muqable banane par decay aik mustaqil naqsha dikhata hai (Fig 19.7).

blocks.alt: Radioactive nuclei ki tadaad N aur waqt t ka graph. Curve t = 0 par No se T1/2 par No/2, 2T1/2 par No/4 aur 3T1/2 par No/8 tak girta, aur 4T1/2 aur 5T1/2 se guzarte hue sifar ki taraf girta rehta hai; dashed lakeerein yeh qeematein dikhati hain. Curve ke paas chhote dabbon mein 16, 8, 4 aur 2 nuqte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.7: waqt ke saath radioactive nuclei ki tadaad (kitab ki Figure 19.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har half-life ke baad baqi nuclei aadhe reh jate hain: No, No/2, No/4, No/8 ...; dabbon ke nuqte 16, 8, 4, 2 isi ko dikhate hain. Curve kabhi bilkul sifar tak nahi pohanchta, is liye koi radioactive element poori tarah khatam nahi hota.

blocks.title: Activity
blocks.text: Radioactive maddah ki activity fi second nikalne wale zarrat ki tadaad (us ki decay ki sharah) hai. Is ki SI ikai becquerel (Bq) hai: 1 Bq = 1 decay fi second. Radiation detector ka record kiya count rate activity ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.title: Half-life
blocks.text: Radioactive namune ki half-life woh waqt hai jis mein us ki activity (ya na toote nuclei ki tadaad) kisi bhi shuru ki qeemat ki aadhi reh jaye.

Do nataij nikalte hain. Pehla, koi radioactive element kabhi poori tarah nahi toot'ta, kyunke har half-life mein baqi nuclei ka sirf aadha toot'ta hai. Doosra, kisi muddat mein toot'ne wale atoms ki tadaad muddat ke shuru mein maujood atoms ke mutanasib hai. Agar N atoms maujood hon to chhote waqfe dt mein toot'ne wale dN, N aur dt ke mutanasib hain: dN = -lambda N dt (19.9), jahan lambda decay constant hai. Bara lambda ka matlab kisi waqfe mein zyada atoms toot'te hain; lambda fi ikai waqt toot'ne wale atoms ka hissa hai, ikai s^-1. Activity A = dN/dt = -lambda N (19.10); manfi nishan batata hai ke N ghatta hai.

Agar namuna No atoms se shuru ho to aik half-life baad No/2 baqi; do half-lives baad (1/2)^2 No; teen ke baad (1/2)^3 No; yun n half-lives baad N = (1/2)^n No baqi rehte hain. n half-lives baad toot chuke atoms No(1 - 1/2^n) (19.11) hain: pehli half-life baad No/2, doosri baad 3No/4, teesri baad 7No/8. Calculus se N = No e^(-lambda t) (19.12), jahan No ibtidai nuclides ki tadaad aur N waqt t baad na toote. Jab N = No/2 ho to t half-life hai: T1/2 = 0.693/lambda (19.13). Yun agar decay constant maloom ho to half-life nikal sakti hai.

blocks.title: Baqi ke muqable toote hue
blocks.text: Kitab equation 19.11, N = No(1 - 1/2^n), ko 'n half-lives baad' baqi tadaad kehti hai; yeh formula toot chuke atoms ki tadaad hai. Baqi tadaad N = No(1/2)^n hai, jaisa kitab khud us se zara pehle kehti hai.

Har radioactive element yahi decay curve rakhta hai, lekin har aik ki half-life mukhtalif hai: uranium-238 ki half-life 4.5 x 10^9 saal aur radium-226 ki 1620 saal, jab ke radon gas ki 3.8 din aur uranium-239 ki sirf 23.5 minute hai. Koi bhi mustahkam element bohat zyada tawanai ke zarrat barsa kar radioactive banaya ja sakta hai, jo nuclei ko excite kar ke ghair-mustahkam bana dete hain; yeh masnoi radioactive anasir hain.

Polonium-210 ki half-life 140 din hai. Agar shuru mein polonium ke 1000 atoms hon to 280 din mein kitne toot'te hain? Hal: pehle 140 din mein 1000/2 = 500 toot'te, 500 baqi; agle 140 din mein 500/2 = 250 toot'te. 280 din mein kul toote = 500 + 250 = 750.

Americium-241 masnoi taur par banaya gaya radioactive element hai. 5.1 ug kamiyat ke namune ki activity 5.9 x 10^5 Bq hai. (i) namune mein nuclei ki tadaad, (ii) decay constant aur (iii) saalon mein half-life maloom karein. Hal: (i) N = (kamiyat / molar kamiyat) x NA = (5.1 x 10^-6 g / 241 g) x 6.02 x 10^23 = 1.27 x 10^16. (ii) A = lambda N se lambda = 5.9 x 10^5 s^-1 / 1.27 x 10^16 = 4.65 x 10^-11 s^-1. (iii) T1/2 = 0.693/lambda = 1.49 x 10^10 s = 1.49 x 10^10 / (60 x 60 x 24 x 365) saal = 472 saal.

blocks.title: Misal 19.3 ki chhapi ghaltiyan
blocks.text: Kitab ke sawal mein 'emit 5.9 x 10^-6 g particles' likha hai, hal mein Avogadro number 6.02 x 10^-23 chhapa hai, nuclei ki tadaad ke liye 'nucleons ki tadaad' istemal hui hai, aur hal A = lambda N (equation 19.10) ke liye 'Eq 19.16' ka hawala deta hai. Aakhri jawab (1.27 x 10^16, 4.65 x 10^-11 s^-1, 472 saal) durust hain; americium-241 ki maqbool half-life taqreeban 432 saal hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar radionuclide ki half-life 30 minute ho to 2 ghante baad kitna hissa baqi rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: 2 ghante 4 half-lives hain, is liye (1/2)^4 = 1/16 baqi rehta hai.

items: Decay be-tarteeb aur khud-ba-khud; bare namune naqshe ki pairvi karte.
A = lambda N (Bq); N = No e^(-lambda t); T1/2 = 0.693/lambda.
